mailRules: AgentMail: once Tower has handled a message (captured to the board, routed to the plan or Roundup, or ignored per its adapter), mark it read. Leave anything unhandled or needing Andrew unread. Gmail read state is left alone.

hosting.notes: No spare machine. Start on a ~$5/mo cloud server; move to a Mac mini M4 (or N100 mini PC for text only) once usage is clear.

calendarRules: Before proposing a calendar event found in email, search all calendars in divisions for the same thing (title keywords, date, ±1 day, any time zone, including Gmail-created events). If it already exists, don't propose a new one. If its time or details differ from the email, propose a fix to the existing event instead.
notificationRules: Scheduled and on-demand runs are silent in chat. Results go to the Chief of Staff page. Only report in chat when there's an actual error: a failed tool call or write, an approved proposal that couldn't be done, or a source that couldn't be read.

checkCadence.note: Hourly checks are paused (Oct 20) to save cost. The page wakes Tower when Andrew approves a proposal or sends a message (one run, then at most one more per 90s). The morning brief does the daily Gmail and calendar sweep.

microsoft.note: Personal Microsoft account. Map Outlook calendars to divisions here after connecting (GET /api/microsoft/calendars); "default" is the main calendar.

emailRules: An approved Send: proposal (from the page or 'approve n') is permission to send that one email from Andrew's Gmail to the recipient shown, on the thread. Never email anyone else.
